decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.The proposed development by reason of its siting and location would result in the loss of backland gardens, which it is considered provides a habitat for trees, plant species and wildlife. The loss of these features would be contrary to Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.N.2.6 Landscape Features) and ENV.N.2.7 (Trees and Community Woodlands) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed access by reason of its siting location and width, would provide an access through a back alley without surveillance, which is inadequately lit, poorly surfaced and inaccessible for disabled persons and emergency services. Furthermore, no separation is made between the pedestrian access and that used by motor vehicles. This is contrary policies ENV.B.1.1, ENV.B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People With Disabilities), ENV.B.1.9 (Safety and Security) T.2.1 (Pedestrian access) and T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security) to the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 3 - 3. The proposed dwelling by reason of footprint, massing and detailed design is considered to be out of keeping and would not preserve the character and appearance of the Spring Grove Conservation Area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 4 - 3. The proposed dwelling by reason of footprint, massing and detailed design is considered to be out of keeping and out of context with the Spring Grove Conservation Area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of 2 x semi detached, 3 x bedroom dwelling houses and associated parking to existing site.
